cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: Sika® Remover-208 is a solvent-based, colourless, clear cleaning agent for painted substrates. It is also used to remove traces of Sikaflex® products.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Areas Of Application
s: Sika® Remover-208 is used to pre-clean strongly contaminated, non-porous substrates. Sika® Remover-208 can be used to clean painted surfaces prior to bonding. Sika® Remover-208 can also be used to remove uncured excess of Sikaflex® adhesive or sealant from application tools or soiled surfaces.
This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Method Of Application > Removal of uncured material
cl.x: Remove the bulk of the Sikaflex® residue with a knife or spatula. Moisten a rag or towel with Sika® Remover-208 and wipe off the remaining adhesive or sealant.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Method Of Application > Surface Cleaning
s: Wipe painted surfaces with a rag or towel moistened with Sika® Remover-208. Wet the paper towel with Sika® Remover-208 by pouring the liquid onto the cloth. Never dip the paper towel into the Sika® Remover-208 as it may contaminate it! Wipe the surface with the wetted paper towel. Use fresh paper towels regularly in order to retain the cleansing power.
Before the solvent dries on the surface (evaporates), wipe it off with a clean, dry, lint-free paper towel.
Repeat the last two steps until no contaminants show up on a white paper towel.
Do not use on sensitive surfaces such as fresh paints.
Tightly reseal container immediately after each use.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Note
s: Compatibility with the actual substrate is to be verified prior to application.
Discard any Sika® Remover-208 that looses its clear appearance (contaminated).
